name: ParPabena Incomplete Order Lead Capture
author: mihanz

sections.description:
ParPabena Incomplete Order Lead Capture helps store administrators track and manage incomplete shopping carts and customer leads efficiently.

This plugin is developed by Minhaz Uddin. It securely captures cart statuses and improves overall store management workflows without adding unnecessary bloat.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/parpabena-incomplete-order directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure your preferences from the plugin settings page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support WooCommerce?

Yes, it is specifically designed to work seamlessly with WooCommerce stores.

Who is the developer?

This plugin is developed by Minhaz Uddin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fixed a database activation error caused by invalid DEFAULT values on TEXT/LONGTEXT columns.
  • Corrected the text domain to match the plugin slug.
  • Improved the WooCommerce dependency check so a missing WooCommerce install is reported to the admin instead of silently doing nothing.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of the ParPabena Incomplete Order Lead Capture plugin.
